{{Quote|So here's what you're going to do. First, you're going to make a pardon disc. You can give it to your friend there."<br />"Who, me?"<br />"My ship will come and pick him up and take him to the prison. Understand?|Cad Bane negotiates with Chancellor Palpatine and Senator Orn Free Taa|<ref name="HC">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
A '''pardon disc''' was a device used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to issue a pardon for [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war and release them from [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had one made for the incarcerated [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid on the Senate]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] took the disc to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] to free Ziro and comply with Bane's demands.
